name: DataTransferObject
summary: An object that carries data across a boundary in one call, to avoid paying for many.

roles.name: DataTransferObject
roles.summary: A shape that exists for a call, not for a model: no behaviour, no invariants, and fields chosen by what one remote consumer needs in one round trip. Serialising a domain object instead is the mistake it exists to prevent, because the model then cannot change without breaking a consumer.
